reviews.title: Great gadget
reviews.comment: I picked up the mic and transmiter thinking it’d be a cute little accessory, but this 7.9g gremlin delivers full “professional production team” energy. Setup is basically nonexistent—it just connects and goes, like it has somewhere important to be. The audio is insanely crisp (48kHz, apparently it has standards), and the noise reduction actually works, which is great because my environment sounds like a reality show meltdown. Also, the range is ridiculous—I wandered way farther than I needed to and it still didn’t drop me, and the battery just keeps going (around 10 hours, which is longer than my motivation). Five stars. It’s tiny, magnetic, and somehow more reliable than most people I know. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.author: Need$4NinjaLessons

reviews.title: Better than expected.
reviews.comment: Works well and pairs well with the Insta 360 line of cameras. Build quality is good and sounds very clean. It's the perfect size with great portability and good value for the money.
reviews.author: SJF

reviews.title: Compact and Great Quality.
reviews.comment: Super compact and great sound quality. The mic connects to the X5 seamlessly and has multiple mounting options. It also includes a wind buffer ring and compact carrying case. You have options to select either sound track from the onboard mic or this BT mic which improves functionality. I have only used a few times so I am not sure of the overall battery life, but it made it through one X5 extended battery and charged quickly out of the box. I am concerned about losing it, especially when recording on a motorcycle or OneWheel, so I would prefer if there was a snap-mount or mounting loop for a safety lanyard. The magnet mount seems strong but it would still be easy to knock off and lose - its only about the diameter of a US Quarter.
reviews.author: R. Mumma

reviews.title: Great mic
reviews.comment: Once you learn how to connect it this is a really great mic and great for catching the audio for my camera. It appears well and it’s very clear. The battery life is pretty decent, but it is sometimes hard to tell how to charge it is even after leaving it on the charger for a few hours. The function is pretty well.
reviews.author: Cheyenne Bell

reviews.title: It works great.
reviews.comment: My only problem, and it's a small one, is that it doesn't connect automatically when turned on. I have to go to the settings in the camera, and turn on Bluetooth every time I use it. Then it shows up on the screen, I click it, and it's connected. Takes a few seconds extra. Otherwise, it's great. Moving the microphone up to my helmet, instead of using the built in mic on the camera, which is mounted to my handlebar, cuts out a lot of road noise, and really increases the sound quality on my e-bike rides.
reviews.author: Leslie F. Hartness
